Preventive controls include roof and yard netting where appropriate, restricted sightlines from public areas, tamper-evident inspections, staff training on suspicious packages, and a documented policy for safe lawful counter-drone responses. After the exercise, measure detection time, handoff time, false alarms, and whether every decision was recorded. This gives officers actionable countermeasures without teaching an intruder how to complete the delivery.
